value.rationale: For all minimal bidegree (4,4) smooth space-filling curves over F3, the Jacobian p-rank is forced to 8 or 9, with exact ordinary vs one-step-nonordinary distribution and a unique ordinary ambient orbit. Such a natural arithmetic-geometric stratification is not determined by the known existence or smooth-presentation count and is useful for understanding the ordinary locus of highly constrained genus-nine curves.
